caption: Doves sit in cages during an annual bird singing competition in Narathiwat, Thailand.
Frontignan, France Police clash with fishers during a blockade of an oil depot. French fishers are protesting against rising fuel costs and EU restrictions on the number of permitted fishing days.

Pristina, Kosovo Supporters of the former president Hashim Thaçi take to the streets in protest after the 58-year-old was found guilty of war crimes. Thaçi was sentenced at a hearing at The Hague to 25 years in prison for crimes committed during Kosovo’s independence war against Serbia in the 1990s.

Gaza City Rescue workers search for dozens of people trapped after a six-storey building housing about 100 displaced Palestinian people collapsed, killing at least 20 people. The building had previously been hit by Israeli strikes during the war, leaving its structure badly weakened and at risk of collapse.

Sana’a, Yemen Pickup trucks travel in a mass funeral procession for Houthi officers and other military personnel killed in fighting against Saudi-backed government forces. The conflict in Yemen has intensified in recent weeks, with the Houthi rebels now controlling the country’s west coast and launching strikes on Saudi oil infrastructure as well as shipping.

Kramatorsk, Ukraine A woman collects items from her home after it was destroyed during an airstrike while she was at a street market. A Russian drone strike on a bus near the frontline in southern Ukraine killed at least five people and injured seven others on Wednesday.

Ma’arrat al-Nu’man, Syria Displaced children pass a mountain of rubbish at a dump, where people scavenge for plastic and metal that can be sold for recycling. Approximately 5.5 million people remain internally displaced in Syria after years of conflict, according to the UN.

Durban, South Africa A young boy reaches for his father’s hand as refugees and asylum seekers board a bus for transfer to the Lindela Repatriation Centre. A total of 274 individuals were transferred to the immigration detention facility, according to the South African government.
Paris, France Workers stand on top of the Olympic cauldron at Tuileries Garden as the structure is dismantled and put into storage for the winter.
Banda Aceh, Indonesia A student performs the rapa’i geleng, a traditional Acehnese dance, during a cultural schools exhibition.

Gaziantep, Turkey Tomato and pepper pastes are made using traditional methods before winter. Often homemade, the pastes practically turn the city’s balconies and rooftops red as they are left to dry in the sun.
Narathiwat, Thailand Doves sit in cages during an annual bird singing competition. Entries compete for a Princess Sirindhorn royal trophy.
A smiling shepherd leaning on a crook and wearing a wooly covering, standing with his back to row of riot police.
Los Angeles, US Welsh actor Matthew Rhys wins outstanding lead actor in a comedy for Widow’s Bay and outstanding lead actor in a limited series for his role in The Beast in Me at the Emmys.
Los Angeles, US Actor Megan Stalter arrives for the 78th Emmy awards dressed up as a life-sized Emmy statuette.

Gaza City, Gaza Supporters chant as they carry the body of Ahmed al-Batsh, a commander of al-Qassam Brigades – the military wing of Hamas – for burial after he was killed by an Israeli airstrike on his car.
Aden, Yemen A fisher at Sirah fish market.
Düzce, Turkey A praying mantis (Mantis religiosa). The predatory insect is characterised by its remarkable triangular head, capable of turning 180 degrees.
Bucharest, Romania A shepherd stands in front of a row of riot police during a farming protest.
Bucharest, Romania Riot police spray teargas after scuffles with demonstrators during a protest against EU farming policies.
Springfield, Ohio, US Denise Gedeon, the wife of pastor Joubert Adrien, who was detained by ICE, spends an entire night and day praying for her husband.
Beaufort, France French-Swiss artist Guillaume Legros, known as Saype, works on his latest giant fresco depicting a human hand clutching a dog’s paw on a mountain pasture above the Col de la Laie.
Inner Mongolia, China An improved version of the Zhuque-2E Y7 carrier rocket blasts off from the Dongfeng commercial space innovation pilot zone. The rocket deployed 10 networking satellites.

Fos-sur-Mer, France Riot police stand by a pallet fire after removing several dozen fishers blocking an oil depot in the port to protest against rising fuel prices and deteriorating working conditions.
Hokkaido, Japan US army paratroopers jump out of a USAF C-130J Super Hercules during a joint airborne exercise.

Kathmandu, Nepal Devotees offer prayers on the banks of the Bagmati River at the end of the three-day Teej festival, in which Hindu women fast during the day and pray for the long lives of their husbands.

A woman in black sunglasses is playing a double-ended hand drum that is hung around her neck. She is in front other women, some of whom appear to be singing and dancing, and all are dressed in red and gold.
Quito, Ecuador People form a human chain to fight a wildfire near their neighbourhood.
Banjarmasin, Indonesia Rescue teams evacuate a survivor after a passenger ferry capsized due to bad weather while carrying 243 people.
Al-Mawasi, Gaza Strip A displaced Palestinian boy inspects damage to a tent after an Israeli drone strike.
Aleppo, Syria A protester burns tyres during a demonstration about the increase in fuel prices.

Cotabato City, the Philippines Supporters of a political group cheer after destroying a vehicle believed to contain firearms during the first parliamentary elections of the Bangsamoro autonomous region in Muslim Mindanao.
Dhading, Nepal A man walks along a mud-covered road near his house that was damaged in last month’s deadly floods.
South Carolina, US A young child plays in the sand as a storm passes off shore in Isle of Palms.

Scheveningen, the Netherlands Members of the cavalry honorary escort practise on the beach before Prinsjesdag (Prince’s Day), when the monarch travels to deliver the speech from the throne in The Hague.
Rio de Janeiro, Brazil A supporter of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva attends a political rally at Copacabana beach.
Kuwait City, Kuwait Students arrive for the first day of school after the three-month summer holidays.
Mumbai, India Devotees put an idol of the Hindu deity Ganesha on to the back of a truck during the Ganesh Chaturthi festival.
Vatican City Street artist JR poses in front of his work Diluvium, at the Vatican Apostolic Library, during the inauguration of the exhibition Catastrophe and Wonder.
